structured_output.summary: Added RequestBodyLimitMiddleware (pure ASGI) in starlette/middleware/body_limit.py, plus tests in tests/middleware/test_body_limit.py. I couldn't run anything, so none of it has been run. The middleware counts received bytes and raises RequestBodyTooLarge from the receive wrapper once the limit is crossed. It sends a text/plain 413 "Content Too Large" only if the response hasn't started. Content-Length is only a fail-fast check. An inner instance unwraps the outer limiter's receive through a private scope key, so inner limits can raise or lower the outer one. One known gap for the wiring task: an outer limiter still rejects a large declared Content-Length before routing, so an inner route can't raise the limit for such a request.

criteria_notes.note: test_over_limit_with_content_length: 413, text/plain, body 'Content Too Large', endpoint not run.
test_streaming_body_without_content_length uses a chunked generator body and gets 413 from received bytes.
test_understated_content_length: Content-Length 5 with a 20-byte body gets 413 when the limit is 10.
test_declared_content_length_rejected_without_receive: 413 and the receive call list is empty. test_invalid_content_length_is_ignored covers the non-numeric header branch.

test_multipart_upload: the smaller upload succeeds and the larger one gets 413 because boundaries and headers count. test_multipart_over_limit_mid_stream covers a multipart body that crosses the limit mid-stream without Content-Length.

test_no_second_response_when_response_started: only http.response.start is sent and the app's receive raised RequestBodyTooLarge. test_receive_keeps_raising_and_passes_disconnect covers repeated raising and http.disconnect passthrough.

test_non_http_scope_passes_through and test_pure_asgi_and_no_new_exports check non-http passthrough and that the class is not a BaseHTTPMiddleware subclass. test_inner_limiter_overrides_outer covers the raise and lower cases, and test_base_http_middleware_reading_body_is_limited adds a BaseHTTPMiddleware case.
test_pure_asgi_and_no_new_exports checks that starlette and starlette.middleware have no RequestBodyLimitMiddleware attribute. The tests import the class from starlette.middleware.body_limit.
